from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional

class CompanyFinancialRecord(BaseModel):
    """A financial record for a company extracted from a single document."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="Name of the company as named in the document")
    stock_code: Optional[str] = Field(description="Stock code if mentioned in the document, otherwise null")
    operating_revenue: float = Field(description="Operating revenue amount")
    net_profit: float = Field(description="Net profit attributable to shareholders amount")
    currency: str = Field(description="Currency of the reported figures (e.g., 'CNY')")
    period: str = Field(description="Reporting period string (e.g., '2025-Q1')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregation of all company financial records extracted from the document collection."""
    company_financial_records: list[CompanyFinancialRecord]
